selection.altText: Elderly man with glasses sitting in an armchair in a warmly lit room.
selection.creator: cottonbro studio
selection.rationale: A person is in a room and nothing is being asked of them. An older man sits in an armchair in an ordinary, warmly lit domestic room with nothing in his hands and nothing arranged around him: no device to work, no document to sign, no meal to finish, no occasion to be dressed for, no money or paperwork anywhere in the frame. The shot therefore cannot propose that anything is owed, missing or at risk - which is the whole point of this beat. Because there is no task, no audience and no result on display, there is nothing for the frame to prove either, so doing nothing is simply what an ordinary afternoon looks like. It is unremarkable on purpose: no styled interior, no product, no performance, no drama. Concretely against the exception: no wallet, cash, bills or financial difficulty (the outgoing shot's problem); no work, study or productivity activity and nothing accomplished on display; no visible sadness, loneliness or defeat - the posture is ordinary rest, not collapse, and nothing in the room signals a problem; no medical or caregiving imagery; no celebration, reward or retirement-lifestyle advertising (a plain room and a plain armchair, no styling, no luxury, no product); and no conspicuously cinematic or aspirational framing. Register-wise it is also the right shape here: N015-S1 is the same person at a desk full of apparatus not required to touch, and this shot is the plain-room counterpart with nothing to pick up.
selection.whyThisMedium: Content could be verified before it entered the cut. The exception this shot replaces was caused by an in-frame object that the sourcing record never described (the wallet), so the replacement was verified through three independent channels on the Pexels API: the asset's own alt text, its page slug, and the alt texts of the neighbouring asset ids that belong to the same shoot. A still also makes that verification complete - there is no unobserved in-shot action inside the 6.667s. Stills are an established treatment in this cut: N011-S2 is already a still slot under the NO_MOTION_STILLS gate, and the v07 motion-QA re-verifies it with the same ssim >= 0.98 / blend-diff Y <= 4.0 test used for every still in the film.

5468x3645 (aspect 1.50, so the 16:9 cover crop trims about 7.8% of the height from each end, less than the cut's existing still N011-S2 at 12.5% per end), average colour #534B45 (a warm, low-key interior tone - note this is darker and warmer than a neutral daylight room, which is consistent with the uploader's word 'warmly lit' and is recorded here rather than glossed over), photographer cottonbro studio, Pexels License.

residualRisks: The uploader's alt text says 'warmly lit' and the neighbouring shot says 'serene', and the asset's own average colour (#534B45) is a warm low-key interior tone rather than a neutral daylight one. That is warmer and moodier than strictly neutral. It is not lifestyle advertising - no styling, product, luxury or aspirational framing appears in the asset or its shoot - and the cut already carries a dark warm interior still at N011-S2 (average colour #242021), so this reads as the same kind of room light rather than a new register. A reviewer who wants a flatter, brighter room should say so at Gate 2; that was the one criterion this asset could not satisfy, because the only asset with a fully neutral description (30736847) turned out to be a studio portrait set.

An older subject seated in an armchair sits one step away from the retirement cliche. It is kept out by the plain room and the absence of any display or treat, and by the film's existing rule that no shot may look like it is selling retirement.
The person's age is not specified beyond 'elderly man' in the alt text and 'an elderly man' in the slug, so no narrower age can be claimed.

Pexels served HTTP 403 for every page-level fetch of candidate asset pages during this pass, so the uploader's page topic tags could not be read for this asset. Verification rests on the three API channels above instead.

The frame itself was never visually inspected by the agent. Content evidence is textual (alt text, slug, same-shoot context), which is why a still was chosen over a video: a still has no unobserved action inside its 6.667s.

screeningSummary.sources: Pexels only, as used by the rest of this cut.
screeningSummary.passes: about 1,500 photo and video results were screened across roughly 40 queries on two channels (API alt text and asset page slug), after first narrowing to the slot's meaning with editorial queries derived from the approved storyboard intent.
screeningSummary.finding: There is effectively no unstaged 'person alone, doing nothing' image on this provider: every one is sold as either a mood (thoughtful, contemplative, alone, tired, dim) or a lifestyle (cozy, comfortable, warm, styled). The replacement was therefore chosen as the single asset whose description carries no mood word, no task, no prop, no status object and no styling, and whose shoot context confirms it was not produced for a mood, health or marketing campaign.
screeningSummary.verificationLimit: Pexels returned HTTP 403 for all page-level fetches during this pass, so uploader topic tags could not be read. Alt text, page slug and same-shoot context were used instead. This is recorded here rather than papered over: the slug channel is what exposed the smoking shot (15092704) that the alt text had hidden.
